Blank Nodes

Released Aug 1, 2025, 14 min

Play Blank Nodes on YouTube
Watch on YouTube

We use existential statements all the time: I know somebody. The coffee is in a cup. The event happened some time. How can we express this in OWL/RDF? We use blank nodes. Today, I'll introduce the concept and show you how they work.

Stay tuned for a coming video about their dangers. Blank nodes are super useful, but they can get you into trouble.
